== Description ==

[[Mike Kessling]] (left seat, blue “New Allies / SWCCG” tee, short brown hair, smiling, holding a card box) and [[Ziemowit Skwara]] (right seat, black zip hoodie over a graphic tee, glasses, short greying hair, thumbs up, wedding ring) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
